name: tally-write-mcp
description: Read TallyPrime data and create, alter and delete vouchers (incl. item invoices and stock journals), ledgers, stock items, groups, godowns and units, with an automatic data backup before every change.

TALLY_HOST.title: Tally host
TALLY_HOST.description: Host or IP of the PC running TallyPrime

TALLY_AUTO_BACKUP.title: Backup before every change
TALLY_AUTO_BACKUP.description: Copy the company data folder before each create/alter/delete

TALLY_BACKUP_KEEP.title: Backups to keep per company
TALLY_BACKUP_KEEP.description: Oldest are removed beyond this number (0 = keep all)
